system.name: CtCAE
system.one_liner: Contrastive-trained complex-valued autoencoder that discovers objects without supervision by synchronising phases, handling more than three colour objects.

content.variant_note: a vertical encoder-decoder with magnitude and phase maps feeds a grid of address-over-feature cells from which one anchor, one positive and five negatives are sampled and tied to the anchor by plus and minus arrows
content.argues: Positive (green) and negative (red) feature pairs are sampled around one anchor address (a magnitude patch) and contrasted through their phase features.
content.subject: A complex-valued autoencoder's magnitude and phase outputs, and the sampling of positive and negative address-feature pairs for one anchor.

lessons.what_to_learn: Explain a pair-sampling scheme for a contrastive loss on a real grid of items: show the model's output maps with a patch grid and the anchor cell marked X, lay the candidate cells out as a coloured grid, outline the sampled ones in the role colour, and link them to labelled boxes with a green plus arrow and red minus arrows.
lessons.suits: contrastive or metric-learning methods where choosing which pairs count as positive or negative is the novelty.

evidence: Sampling process of positive (green) and negative (red) pairs for one anchor (purple) in the CtCAE model.
Anchor address (the purple box marked with an X) corresponds to the patch of magnitude values
we contrast the encoder output in an identical manner

summary: The paper introduces CtCAE, a complex-valued autoencoder for unsupervised object discovery in which binding information lives in the phase of the activations, trained with a new contrastive loss. Figure 1 shows how that loss samples pairs for one anchor. At the left, a vertical encoder and decoder (two trapezoids) take a multi-object scene and give magnitude and phase maps, shown as patch-grid overlays with the anchor patch marked X. At the right, a 3 x 5 grid stacks coloured address squares (magnitudes) over white boxes with arrows (phase features); the purple anchor sits at the left, one green-outlined column is the positive, five red-outlined columns are negatives, and grey curved arrows copy them to labelled boxes tied to the anchor by a green plus arrow and red minus arrows.
summary_zh: CtCAE 用复数值自编码器做无监督物体发现，绑定信息存在相位里，并以新的对比损失训练。图左为编码器、解码器和幅值/相位图（X 标锚点），图右为地址-特征格网：一个紫色锚点、一个绿框正样本、五个红框负样本，经加减号弧线相连。
notes: The roles (purple anchor, green positive, red negative) come from the caption; the criterion for choosing the columns and the meaning of the shades along each grid row are not in the evidence (they are described in Section 3). The bottom-to-top direction of the encoder-decoder column is inferred from stacking, there are no arrows. The prior attribute panels=2 was not followed: the left column and the right grid are unframed regions of one drawing.
